info.name: Thornode Auth Dynamic L1 Fees API

params.name: height
params.description: optional block height, defaults to current tip

items.docs:
Returns every stored dynamic L1 fee record (ADR-026). Each entry is a
thorname/pair tuple with its current `dynamic_bps`, whitelist state,
last active epoch, and latest sealed-epoch fees in TOR (1e8-precision
USD value).

params.name: height
params.description: optional block height, defaults to current tip

params.name: thorname
params.description: the thorname to look up dynamic fee state for

items.docs:
Returns the dynamic L1 fee state and full epoch history for every
pair tracked for the given thorname (ADR-026).

params.name: height
params.description: optional block height, defaults to current tip

items.docs:
Returns the in-progress (current epoch, not yet sealed) dynamic L1 fee
accumulators (ADR-026). Each entry has the thorname/pair tuple and the
live volume and fees recorded so far this epoch in TOR (1e8-precision
USD value). The response also includes the current epoch number.
